posts.author: mei
posts.text: Playtest, three rounds, 40 testers: 19 of the 29 who reached level 5 quit there. Most of them quit at the boss order, not on the level itself. Full numbers are in the playtest stats table.

posts.author: arjun
posts.text: That spike is brutal. Is the checkpoint before the boss too far back? If they have to replay the whole rush every attempt, that will feel unfair.

posts.author: mei
posts.text: Level 5 is meant to be the wall before the finale. That's the point. It should feel hard, and the boss is supposed to teach the combo timing.

posts.author: weiling
posts.text: 19 out of 29 quitting before level 6 is not a difficulty curve, it is a leak. We lose the upgrade tree and the finale if they never get there.

posts.author: arjun
posts.text: We could add a checkpoint after the satay cart. That is maybe half a day of work, and it keeps the boss hard.

posts.author: mei
posts.text: If we soften it now, the finale loses its payoff. I would rather add one hint and keep the wall.

posts.author: daniel
posts.text: Wishlist conversion drops when streamers hit a wall on stream. Just saying. Level 5 is the part they will show first.

posts.author: mei
posts.text: Streamers are not our median player. They play for the reaction, not the upgrade tree.

posts.author: weiling
posts.text: We are out of time for this today. Let's park it and revisit after launch? I don't want to guess the tuning in the last week.

posts.author: arjun
posts.text: I'll log it, but I don't want to guess the tuning either. No decision from me until we look at the numbers together.

posts.author: arjun
posts.text: The new chicken rice stall front is in build 0.9.7. Texture atlas is about 2MB over budget though.

posts.author: mei
posts.text: The uncle's apron colour is wrong. It should be a faded blue, not the bright one from the first pass.

posts.author: daniel
posts.text: The key art with the carrot cake hero looks great. That is the one I want for the store page.

posts.author: arjun
posts.text: I can drop the extra steam frames and get most of the 2MB back. Nobody will notice at phone size.

posts.author: mei
posts.text: Do it. The steam was a nice idea but it is eating the budget.

posts.author: daniel
posts.text: Wishlist count is 3,120 as of Monday. The store page has been live for three weeks.

posts.author: weiling
posts.text: Booth budget is SGD 1,800 all-in and we have spent SGD 1,450. That includes the banner and stickers, which are already paid for. 350 is left for the trailer and contingency.

posts.author: daniel
posts.text: Starfruit wants the launch trailer by the 18th so they can schedule it. I need capture footage by the 16th.

posts.author: arjun
posts.text: The trailer capture build needs the save fix and the night market frame rate fix. Save fix is in; frame rate is not.

posts.author: weiling
posts.text: Indie Arcade SG asked us to confirm our booth size this week. Daniel, can you check the organiser email before you reply?

posts.author: daniel
posts.text: Will do. I'll bring the roll-up banner and 200 stickers. The QR code for the wishlist page is already printed.

posts.author: arjun
posts.text: Lunch at the kampung food court? I need to get out of this chair.

posts.author: mei
posts.text: Yes. I want the curry puff place, the one with the long queue.

posts.author: daniel
posts.text: I'm getting chicken rice. Meet at the lift in ten.

posts.author: weiling
posts.text: Grab me a kopi-o please. No sugar.
